children: Ryan Hicke, an officer serving as Chief Executive Officer, reported a sale of company stock. The filing lists a weighted average selling price of $110.711 per share. The total reported sale amount was $4,151,662. Following the transaction, Hicke Ryan directly owns 192,814 shares and indirectly owns 15,167 shares via a 401(k) plan. The filing notes the price is a weighted average of sales ranging from $110.35 to $110.91 and that some shares were received as employment compensation.
